reasons.auth: API keys are generated via the API addon and used in simple HTTP requests; the MCP server uses token headers, both documented in the help center.
reasons.access: A free Pumble account can be created, the API addon installed, and an API key generated at no cost, providing working credentials.
reasons.mcp: Pumble publishes an official MCP server (https://mcp.pumble.com/mcp) with documentation for connecting AI agents.
reasons.verdict: Public API documentation, free self‑serve credentials, and an official MCP server are available, so a toolkit can be built today.
